t: You're on Seymour Place, a street in Marylebone that runs north from Seymour Street until it meets Marylebone Road, where it becomes Lisson Grove. Marble Arch is a short walk to the southeast, and Edgware Road is just to the west. Gloucester Place runs parallel to the east. The reason to pause here is that James Hamilton, later the first Duke of Abercorn, was born on this street. He grew up to be a Conservative statesman, and he twice served as Lord Lieutenant of Ireland.
